data.long_description:
Presented by  Properties, this stunning 4-bedroom villa by nakheel in Jebel Ali Village offers an exceptional blend of space, privacy, perfect for families whos looking for a premium rental home.

Set on a generous plot of 6,781 sq ft, the villa by Nakheel features a thoughtfully designed layout with a bright and airy open-plan living and dining area, four spacious bedrooms, and four well-appointed bathrooms.

The home is finished with modern touches and high-quality materials, creating a comfortable and elegant living environment.

Positioned on a single row, the property ensures enhanced privacy and a family-friendly atmosphere. Its prime location just a short walk from the pool and park makes it ideal for outdoor living and family activities.
Located within one of Dubai's most desirable communities, Jebel Ali Village offers easy connectivity to major roads, schools, retail destinations, and key city hotspots.
